headline: The work-breakdown-structure area covers one broad ticket — creating and running tasks from a team plan, Excel import, AI-generated breakdowns, file export, and Kanban/calendar/graph views — and the code reviewed so far does not settle whether any of it is in place.
what_is_there: The code examined shows scheduling and calendar date handling (including holidays) and a bulk Excel import used for administrator account creation. There is an indirect reference to a task-related Excel routine, but that part of the code was not among the files reviewed.
what_is_unclear: Nothing about the WBS ticket could be confirmed or ruled out: task creation from a team plan, AI-generated breakdowns, export, and the Kanban, dependency-aware calendar, and graph views were all absent from the files inspected, which were only a keyword-selected slice of the codebase.
suggested_action: Ask the team which part of the product holds the task and WBS functionality, and re-run the check against that area — starting with the task-side Excel import that was referenced but not reviewed.
